title: Louis T Mother's NDE
content:
My mom only speaks Spanish and is currently 79 and still mentally sharp. Last night, I went over the details with her again and she decided to share her experience.

This is the story my mom had always told me growing up. At the time, she was giving birth to me on Tuesday, October 1st. She was on the operating table because they needed to perform a C-section. She said she remembers passing out. Instantly, she was having an out-of-body experience and floated over everyone. She said she could see my dad and the nurses. She was watching some commotion going on. She later learned that she had flatlined for three minutes. My dad confirmed it by freaking out that his wife just died.

She then found herself on the property where she grew up in the Dominican Republic. Suddenly, a man on a large white horse came over, but he was on the other side of the small river that ran on one side of the farm. She was sitting down and recognized the man. He was an old friend of my grandfathers, who had passed away about 20 years earlier. She hadn't seen him since she was a little girl. She remembers going to his funeral when was about 6 or 7 years old. He said, 'It is not your time and you will go back to your family.' She was calm the entire time and although she didn't fully understand what was going on, she was okay with what he said.

Suddenly, she woke up, back on the operating table. She was giving birth to me.

Throughout my entire life, I've never been worried about dying because of her story. I feel like I've always known that we continue on, after leaving this shell. I've watched countless interviews and read stories of other NDE and my mom's story has always been similar to others; so I know we'll all be okay.

arrival.other_being_detail: A deceased old friend of her grandfather, described as a man on a large white horse, on the other side of a small river by the farm where she grew up.

environment.environment_other_detail: Property/farm where she grew up in the Dominican Republic; a small river ran on one side of the farm.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE over the operating room, then found herself at her childhood farm and encountered a deceased acquaintance who told her it was not her time, then she woke back on the operating table.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Arrival in a familiar earthly location (childhood farm in the Dominican Republic) and encounter with a deceased acquaintance on a large white horse across a small river.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It is not your time and you will go back to your family.”
